supporting_pages.title: Creating resource references \_|\_ Config Connector \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: For example, the YAML referencing the topic myTopic you created earlier is: apiVersion : pubsub.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 kind : PubSubSubscription metadata : name : pubsubsubscription-referencing-topic spec : topicRef : name : myTopic Create the PubSubSubscription with kubectl apply . kubectl --namespace CC NAMESPACE apply -f pubsub-subscription.yaml Replace CC NAMESPACE with the namespace Config Connector manages resources from.

The following YAML file describes a Pub/Sub PubSubSubscription that references a PubSubTopic named myTopic . apiVersion : pubsub.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 kind : PubSubSubscription metadata : name : pubsubsubscription-referencing-topic spec : topicRef : name : myTopic Pub/Sub example Create a PubSubTopic In this example, you create a PubSubSubscription that depends on a PubSubTopic .

Create a PubSubSubscription Copy the following into a file named `pubsub-subscription.yaml: apiVersion : pubsub.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 kind : PubSubSubscription metadata : name : pubsubsubscription-referencing-topic spec : topicRef : name : TOPIC NAME Replace TOPIC NAME with the PubSubTopic name you used in step 1.
